name: reward-04-duplicate-recipient-error
spec_section: serialization.md §6.6 (recipient is a UNIQUE key after aggregation)
exercises: compiler-bug guard: a reward leaf set containing TWO leaves with the same recipient is a HARD ERROR (recipient is a unique key; the SDK's reject-on-ambiguity must fire). Demonstrates the verifier REJECTS malformed compiler output rather than silently building a tree.
why_rejected: After aggregate-one-leaf-per-recipient, `recipient` is a unique primary key; two leaves sharing it can only be a compiler bug and would also collide the per-experiment ClaimReceipt nullifier PDA.
